title: Durable defects in an evidence-gated research agent: a case study

research_questions: RQ1: what classes of durable defects occur in an evidence-gated research agent?
RQ2: which mechanism detected each defect?
RQ3: what did the repair look like (fix type + regression test)?
protocol.case_selection: all six durable failures recorded in research_agent/failures/atlas.json on 2026-11-18; operational failures excluded by construction
protocol.chain_of_evidence: each failure id maps to atlas evidence paths and the regression test or manual check that proved the repair
protocol.triangulation: atlas record + design record + code/test diff at the same id
protocol.member_checking: not performed (single author); declared as a threat
protocol.ethics: internal engineering artifacts only; no human subjects, no personal data

cases.repair: synthesis uses the shared gateway resolver; test_default_model_prefers_gateway_binding
cases.notes: the failure only appeared when a gateway-only configuration was exercised

cases.repair: writer failures become model_failed with a reason; silent fallback test added
cases.notes: artifact claimed deterministic while a model profile was resolved

cases.repair: metric/budget shape warnings; later R1 hardened memory pack

cases.notes: lexical pre-review false negative on comparison wording

cases.repair: act label derives from ACTS.length; verified with Playwright
cases.notes: no automated regression test for rendered labels yet

cases.repair: bare profile ids accepted when the gateway declares them; 5 tests
